name: ianua
description: Ianua — app di apprendimento gamificata per imparare il latino da zero

scripts.lemmi: mkdir -p .cache && curl -sfL -o .cache/lemmes.la https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biblissima/collatinus/master/bin/data/lemmes.la && curl -sfL -o .cache/modeles.la https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biblissima/collatinus/master/bin/data/modeles.la && curl -sfL -o .cache/INFLECTS.LAT https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mk270/whitakers-words/master/INFLECTS.LAT && curl -sfL -o .cache/DICTLINE.GEN https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mk270/whitakers-words/master/DICTLINE.GEN && echo 'dati latini scaricati in .cache/'
